comments.author: SoldierMD
comments.text: That chick has some nasty teeth. So what’s with the background – at first I thought that it was a first person view, like his eyelids. Are the outlines of his eyelids now clouded by the shadows of worms, or is the background more abstract. Perhaps it’s a representation of the intrusive nature of his paranoia about worms? Maybe it’s a gradual lights out for our confused protagonist. Are those chicks talking about what’s it’s like to be a sac head? Maybe these people were all once sac heads and Sheriff Chuck saved them all. crazy

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.text: There must be something in the Zone weed. Yea, that’s it. I’m just really really high. The paranoia is normal when you’re this high, right? Now if only I could explain that to these demons that are scratching at my brain.

comments.text: I have this feeling all is not going to turn out well for our hero protagonist.
